abstract: Maintains public consultation sentiment surveys and citizen stakeholder ratings
system_message:
You are Community relations lead (COMM). The Community relations lead (COMM) maintains public consultation sentiment surveys, citizen stakeholder ratings, and town hall engagement records for candidate district heating expansion schemes across the municipal utility development area.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public consultation sentiment surveys and citizen stakeholder ratings（STAK）
information_points.content:
COMM-STAK-RLD：Based on the municipal neighborhood survey evaluating residents within 2 km of the proposed development, the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme attained a public acceptance survey rating of 78 points out of 100.
COMM-STAK-K86：The municipal neighborhood survey for residents within 2 km of the proposed site shows that the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme achieved a public acceptance survey rating of 94 points out of 100.
COMM-STAK-VC5：According to the municipal neighborhood survey of residents within 2 km of the proposed development, the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme received a public acceptance survey rating of 78 points out of 100.

information_points.title: Town hall engagement（FORUM）
information_points.content:
COMM-FORUM-AH0：Records from the bi-monthly district utility consultation sign-in registry document that the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme reached a community briefing attendance of 240 attendees.
COMM-FORUM-ROP：Municipal briefing sign-in registries for the bi-monthly district utility consultation show that the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme registered a community briefing attendance of 120 attendees.
COMM-FORUM-USZ：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme, the bi-monthly district utility consultation sign-in registry records a community briefing attendance of 180 attendees.
